title: Antimicrobial Consumption and Resistance in Iceland
text:
Introduction
Welcome to the interactive annual report on antimicrobial consumption (AMC) and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in Iceland.
This report presents surveillance data on antibiotic consumption and antimicrobial resistance in humans, highlighting trends over time and providing insights into the development of antimicrobial resistance in Iceland.
The interactive figures and tables allow users to explore the data and monitor changes over time.
The report is developed by the Directorate of Health, Iceland, with the aim of supporting evidence-based decision-making, promoting responsible antibiotic use, and strengthening efforts to combat antimicrobial resistance.
This website is currently under development.
